parameters.query: SELECT id, nome, whatsapp_loja, config_json FROM lojas WHERE id = $1 LIMIT 1;

UPDATE lojas
SET 
  whatsapp_loja = $1,
  config_json = jsonb_set(
    COALESCE(config_json, '{}'::jsonb),
    '{dadosDaLoja,whatsapp_loja}',
    to_jsonb($1::text),
    true
  ),
  updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = $2 AND (whatsapp_loja IS NULL OR whatsapp_loja = '');
